mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_CHARTS, COUNT(DISTINCT CHART_TYPE) AS CHART_TYPES, SUM(CASE WHEN CHART_CONFIG IS NOT NULL AND CHART_CONFIG != '{}' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTERACTIVE_CHARTS, NVL(SUM(USAGE_COUNT), 0) AS TOTAL_EXPORTS FROM TBL_BUDGET_ANALYSIS_CHART WHERE DEL_FLAG = 0
SELECT CHART_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS TYPE_COUNT, NVL(SUM(USAGE_COUNT), 0) AS USAGE_COUNT FROM TBL_BUDGET_ANALYSIS_CHART WHERE DEL_FLAG = 0 GROUP BY CHART_TYPE ORDER BY TYPE_COUNT DESC
